recommendation.thresholdSummary: Action threshold crossed: wind chill −24°F during the morning commute
recommendation.explanation: An Extreme Cold Warning is in effect with wind chills near −24°F between 5 and 8 AM, when employees would be walking from parking and transit stops. Roads are clear and the building has heat, so the hazard is exposure rather than travel. Keeping the office open with unscheduled telework lets 51 telework-ready employees stay home while on-site and essential staff can still report.
recommendation.whatCouldChange: Wind chills forecast above −20°F by 7 AM would support a normal day. A heating or power failure in the building would support a full closure.

alternatives.note: Wind chill is still below the cutoff at 10 AM, so a 2-hour delay does not clear it.
Defensible, but closes the building when roads are clear and it has heat.
Exposes commuters to frostbite risk in under 30 minutes.

alerts.headline: Dangerously cold wind chills as low as 26 below zero. Frostbite possible on exposed skin in as little as 30 minutes.

roads.detail: All monitored routes near the office report clear, dry pavement.
